payload.title: File:Nagatitan Size Comparison.svg
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of the holotype specimen (SM2025-1-546–556) of Nagatitan chaiyaphumensis with an adult human male (~1.8 m) for reference.

References

  • "The first sauropod dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous Khok Kruat Formation of Thailand enriches the diversity of somphospondylan titanosauriforms in southeast Asia"
